# First Tracks!! Online Ski Magazine

> > First Tracks!! Online Ski Magazine is a comprehensive skiing and snowboarding resource featuring trip reports, resort guides, and the Liftlines community forums, founded by Marc Guido and Tony Crocker.

The site combines editorial ski content with an active community forum (Liftlines) where skiers discuss conditions, trip planning, and resorts across North America and internationally. Coverage spans major destinations like Snowbird, Alta, Grand Targhee, and British Columbia cat skiing operations.

## Key Topics

- Powder skiing
- Trip reports
- Cat skiing
- Backcountry skiing
- Snow conditions and snowfall analysis
- Ski resort guides
- Trip planning
- Snowbird and Alta (Utah)
- Grand Targhee
- British Columbia skiing
- California resorts
- New England skiing
- Jay Peak
- Liftlines community forums
- Marc Guido and Tony Crocker (founders)

## About First Tracks

- [Welcome! | First Tracks!! Online Ski Magazine](https://firsttracksonline.com/2022/09/20/welcome): About page introducing founders Marc Guido and Tony Crocker
- [Liftlines Skiing and Snowboarding Forums](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards): Main forum homepage for Liftlines skiing and snowboarding community

## Ski Resort Guides & Planning

- [Las Leñas: A Ski Resort Guide](https://firsttracksonline.com/2006/07/17/las-lenas-a-ski-resort-guide): Comprehensive guide to Las Leñas, Argentina ski resort and terrain
- [How to Plan a Cat Skiing Trip](https://firsttracksonline.com/2016/10/18/how-to-plan-a-cat-skiing-trip): Complete planning guide for cat skiing in BC and worldwide destinations
- [10 Tips to Get In Shape for Ski Season](https://firsttracksonline.com/2017/10/12/10-tips-to-get-in-shape-for-ski-season): Pre-season fitness guide from PSIA-AASI experts like Robin Barnes

## Trip Reports & Forum Discussions

- [Snowbird, UT March 7-10, 2026](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/snowbird-ut-march-7-10-2026.15515): Detailed Snowbird trip report covering Mineral Basin powder skiing
- [Mustang Powder, Jan 10-12 2025](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/mustang-powder-jan-10-12-2025.15238): Mustang Powder cat skiing trip report from January 2025 BC conditions
- [Palisades Tahoe, CA 4/26-28/23](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/palisades-tahoe-ca-4-26-28-23.14766): Trip report from Palisades Tahoe late-season skiing April 2023
- [Tahoe is a mess....The toxic blend of billionaires and angry townies has become unbearable.](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/tahoe-is-a-mess-the-toxic-blend-of-billionaires-and-angry-townies-has-become-unbearable.15217): Forum discussion on Tahoe skiing challenges vs Mammoth Mountain
- [Best Snowfall Tracking Site for Switzerland - White Risk](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/best-snowfall-tracking-site-for-switzerland-white-risk.14715): Discussion of White Risk Swiss government snow data tracking tool
- [Looking for advice for Alta/Snowbird](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/looking-for-advice-for-atla-snowbird.2397): Forum discussion seeking Alta/Snowbird lodging advice for late January
- [Bethel Backcountry](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/bethel-backcountry.5220): Forum thread seeking backcountry info near Sunday River/Bethel area
- [Open Snow Subscription Change 2025](https://firsttracksonline.com/boards/threads/open-snow-subscription-change-2025.15405): Forum discussion on OpenSnow price increase from $31 to $50
